name: inspect
description: /inspect is the plan-check station of the build loop: an adversarial review of a /blueprint build doc BEFORE /build runs it, by an inspector chosen at summon — Claude subagents, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, or local Qwen. Three lenses (traceability, blueprint's own rules as the code book, repo reality), verdicts APPROVED / WITH CONDITIONS / REJECTED, every verdict stamped with the inspector's model id. Strictly user-invoked.
